title: Prepare the Forge
description: The Dark Tower already contains a chamber shaped for a forge, but architecture alone does not make it useful. Acquire the core Hot Iron smithing equipment needed to furnish that chamber and begin restoring the Tower's practical infrastructure.
description_completed: The essential smithing equipment is ready. The Tower now has the material basis for a working forge facility, even though later progression may still expand what that forge can accomplish.

objectives.name: Begin restoring the machinery of rule
Make the first personal mark upon the world
